pages.title: about - tidewell-pharma.test
pages.text:
Tidewell Pharma plc is the registered company behind the Tidewell brand.
Tidewell Pharma has its head office in San Sebastián, Spain.
Tidewell Pharma is led by chief executive officer Mary Anne Cole.
Tidewell Pharma was incorporated in 1987.

pages.title: facts - tidewell-pharma.test
pages.text:
Tidewell Pharma has 1,200 employees.
Tidewell Pharma has raised 12.5 million dollars in funding.
